sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal woman slightly turned viewer left; brown side-part rolled curls, brows, large round bronze-rim dark brown sunglasses fully covering eyes. Brown/taupe broad round neckline dress with tan edging and small red round decorations along shoulder straps; fine dark necklace ending at bottom crop in partly visible gold pendant. Serious closed mouth; blue background. Preserve hair, glasses coverage, dress details, necklace, pose/crop/light. Short broad fitted mascot neck, no human lips.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal woman slightly turned left, blonde side-part waved bob, pale brows, small white pearl stud earrings, dark green round soft cap with olive band. Off-white broad-lapel lab coat and dark green patterned scarf crossed V at neck. Serious closed mouth and blue background. Keep cap/hair/brows/earrings/scarf pattern and outfit, pose/crop/light; round mascot head, short broad fitted neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal woman with light brown side-part rolled hair pinned at nape, brows, black roundish glasses properly over eyes. Dark brown garment with ornate gold/black lace V border, cream-white pointed collar with small round gold center brooch and pale central folded fabric. Serious mouth, blue background. Preserve glasses, hair, brows, decorative border/collar/brooch, pose/crop/light, short broad mascot neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal woman with restrained slight smile, short auburn side-part waved bob, brows, small silver open-diamond barrette at viewer-right temple. Navy broad-lapel coat with small gold shoulder buttons over cream-white high folded blouse whose two gold center buttons and vertical fine pleats are visible. Blue painted background. Keep smile, barrette/hair/brows, coat/blouse/buttons, crop/light; compact round mascot head, short broad fitted neck.
